可秦夙已经腰酸的不行了，她反手背到背后去拽魏知弦的大尾巴，“你别再弄了，我好像有点扛不住了！”

“不行，我不想停下……”魏知弦却作势又要索取！

秦夙赶紧用力扯住他的尾巴，“别！你换个别的方法！”

再胆怯的贴的更近一些。

她试着晓之以情动之以理，“发育中的腺体应该很脆弱吧？我不知道腺体这么使用会不会坏掉，可你应该很清楚，我现在不舒服，你体谅体谅我，嗯？”

魏知弦的尾巴居然真的安分下来。

在秦夙不知道该怎么说下去之后，那尾巴乖乖的卸下力道，从她衣服里抽了出来。

重新卷上她，还安慰性质的用尾巴尖在她脸颊上蹭了几下。

此时魏知弦的呼吸已经平静了不少。

他说话也不再断断续续了。

尽管嗓子还有些沙哑，他接下来的话，却让秦夙意识到，他的理智还在，没有被向导素迷的发疯。

“还有两种方法。”魏知弦把脸颊往秦夙掌心里拱一拱，“一种，是进入我的精神图景，去见我的黑豹，精神力形态下的你只要去抚摸它，就能起到疏导作用。”

“可我，不太敢。”秦夙可不想再拿小触手戳他了。

万一又戳出个濒临暴走，她可怎么办啊！

“另一种，就更冒犯了。”魏知弦脑袋再度偏转，嘴唇蹭到了秦夙的耳尖上，“你需要，吻我，无论战斗型还是治愈型，向导的体液，对哨兵来说，都是极佳的精神净化良药。”

秦夙被他嘴唇磨蹭的心慌死了，听了这种话，就更是慌的六神无主！

“不愿意的话，只好冒险，再试试你的小触手。”魏知弦把脸别向另一侧，远离秦夙，“即便再引发我的不良反应，你也知道，我不会责怪你的，而且白塔不会对我的暴走坐视不理，米娅会来接替你，压制我。”

米娅是个战斗型向导，如果她来，帮助魏知弦的方法，就会带给这男人莫大的痛苦。

可他刚才已经经历过一轮痛苦，秦夙不太忍心。

“首席向导办公室里，不是有一位治愈型的吗？”她还记得离颂掐诺亚那次，她看到的那位身高不到一米七，训练有素的向导。

“不要。”魏知弦却蹙了蹙眉，“目前我只能接受，你碰我。”

“……”秦夙无语了。

“这次我会用我的精神力触手接住你，别太担心。”他又深呼吸了一次，弯起嘴角笑笑，“来吧，再试一次。”

他有勇气承受，秦夙却实在不想再去做可能会错的疏导。

她还是太稚嫩，也太莽撞了。

之前给谢尘无疏导，就戳的他咳嗽不止。

这次又把魏知弦弄成这样。

But Qin Su's back was so sore that she put her hand behind her back and pulled Wei Zhixian's big tail, "Stop it, I can't bear it anymore!"

"No, I don't want to stop..." Wei Zhixian pretended to ask for it again!

Qin Su quickly grabbed his tail and said, "Don't! Try another method!"

He timidly moved closer.

She tried to reason with her emotions, "The developing glands should be very fragile, right? I don't know if the glands will be damaged if they are used like this, but you should know very well that I am not feeling well right now, so you are considerate and considerate of me, okay?"

Wei Zhixian's tail actually calmed down.

After Qin Su didn't know what to say, the tail obediently took off its strength and pulled out of her clothes.

He wrapped himself around her again and rubbed her cheek a few times with the tip of his tail in a comforting manner.

At this time, Wei Zhixian's breathing had calmed down a lot.

His speech was no longer choppy.

Although his voice was still a little hoarse, his next words made Qin Su realize that he was still sane and had not been driven crazy by the guide Su.

"There are two other ways." Wei Zhixian arched his cheek into Qin Su's palm, "One is to enter my mental landscape and see my black panther. In the form of mental power, you only need to touch it and it will have a guiding effect."

"But I don't dare." Qin Su didn't want to poke him with the little tentacle anymore.

What would she do if someone was on the verge of going berserk again?

"The other kind is even more offensive." Wei Zhixian turned his head again, and his lips touched the tip of Qin Su's ear, "You need to kiss me. Regardless of the combat type or the healing type, the guide's bodily fluids are excellent spiritual purification medicine for the sentry."

Qin Su was so flustered by his lips. After hearing these words, she became even more panicked!

"If you don't want to, you have to take the risk and try your little tentacles again." Wei Zhixian turned his face to the other side, away from Qin Su, "Even if it triggers another adverse reaction from me, you know that I will not blame you, and the White Tower will not sit idly by and ignore my rampage. Mia will replace you and suppress me."

Mia is a combat guide. If she comes to help Wei Zhixian, she will cause great pain to the man.

But he had already experienced a round of pain just now, and Qin Su couldn't bear it.

"Isn't there a healing type in the chief guide's office?" She still remembered the time when Li Song pinched Noah, and the well-trained guide she saw was less than 1.7 meters tall.

"No." Wei Zhixian frowned, "For now, I can only accept that you touch me."

"..." Qin Su was speechless.

"I will use my spiritual tentacles to catch you this time, don't worry too much." He took another deep breath, curled up his lips and smiled, "Come on, try again."

He had the courage to bear it, but Qin Su really didn't want to do any more counseling that might be wrong.

She is still too immature and too reckless.

I didn't give Xie Chen any guidance before, just poking him until he coughed.

This time Wei Zhixian was made like this again.
